description.narrative: The proposed Project entails the provision of a working capital loan facility to Oyu Tolgoi LLC (Oyu Tolgoi or the Project Company), to support the completion of its underground mine development. Oyu Tolgoi is developing the Oyu Tolgoi copper and gold mine in the Southern Gobi region of Mongolia. The Oyu Tolgoi mine represents one of the worlds largest copper deposits and is expected to produce around 500,000 metric tons of copper per year by 2029.

This Project will enable Oyu Tolgoi to continue its contribution to Mongolias GDP through value addition and job creation and support the Government of Mongolias fiscal position through continued fiscal transfers, including taxes and royalties. Additionally, the Project will enable one of the largest copper mines in the world to continue growing production, which is anticipated to build resilience in the global copper value chains, and essential for the global energy transition.
